title: Force
html:
For other possible meanings of Force in the game, see:  Force (disambiguation)

⁠Force is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Force, see Category:Sources of Force damage.
  • For creatures weak to Force, see Category:Vulnerable to Force.
  • For creatures resistant to Force, see Category:Resistant to Force.
  • For creatures immune to Force, see Category:Immune to Force.

Sources of Force damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Force damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

  •  Banishing Smite (Melee)

  •  Magic Missile

Weapons

The following weapons deal Force damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Arcane Absorption Dagger - inaccessible
  •  Breaching Pikestaff
  •  Halberd of Vigilance
  •  Ne'er Misser

Equipment

The following equipment add Force damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Force damage through other means.

  •  Faithbreaker: Deals 1d6⁠⁠Force via  Absolute Power.
  •  Viconia's Walking Fortress: Deals 2d4⁠⁠Force via  Bulwark Rebuke.
  •  Craterflesh Gloves: Adds +1d6⁠⁠Force to critical hits.
  •  Stalker Gloves: Adds +1d4⁠⁠Force to sneak attacks.
  •  Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves: Adds +1d4⁠⁠Force to unarmed attacks.
  •  Gauntlet of the Tyrant: Adds +1d4⁠⁠Force to unarmed attacks.
  •  Gloves of Soul Catching: Adds +1d10⁠⁠Force to unarmed attacks.
  •  Garb of the Land and Sky: Adds +1d8⁠⁠Force to your next attack during  Step of the Wind.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Force damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Void Bulb: Deals 1⁠⁠Force in an area.
  •  Smokepowder Bomb: Deals 3d4+9⁠⁠Force in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to halve.
  •  Smokepowder Satchel: Deals 3d4+9⁠⁠Force + 2d6⁠⁠Force in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to halve.
  •  Sanguine Explosive: Deals 4d8⁠⁠Force + 4d8⁠⁠Fire in an area.  DEX Save (DC 17) to halve.
  •  Runepowder Vial: Deals 5d4+18⁠⁠Force in an area.  DEX Save (DC 12) to halve.
  •  Brilliant Retort: Deals 3d4+9⁠⁠Force in an area. (Doubled due to a bug.)  DEX Save (DC 12) to halve damage.
  •  Orthonic Handbomb: Deals 4d8⁠⁠Force + 4d8⁠⁠Fire in an area.  DEX Save (DC 17) to halve damage.
  •  Smokepowder Arrow: Deals 4d6⁠⁠Force + 4d6⁠⁠Fire in an area.  DEX Save (DC 15) to halve damage.
